lines.text: Rain drums on the greenhouse roof. Water runs down the glass.
@maya_front stands at a wooden bench, a small tomato plant before her.
She hums to herself and tips the plant out of its cramped pot.
Pale roots curl tight around the soil. She loosens them with her thumbs.
She settles the plant into a larger pot and pats soil around it.
A drop of rain slides down a leaf. She smiles.
She sets the pot on the sill, where grey light touches the green.

writes.note: I drafted a short, quiet greenhouse scene from your line, all visual, with no spoken words.

reply.rationale: The scene keeps the person's rain, greenhouse, repotting and humming, and expands them into seven short beats, about 14 s, for the 15 s target. I used only @maya_front, the one listed ref, and added no dialogue so no unlisted name is needed.
